subject: Promptset Sentinel: acceptance handoff and cross-func action matrix
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>, Simon Park <simon.park@evaltools.io>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promptset Sentinel: acceptance handoff and cross-func action matrix

Team —

I put together an initial "Sentinel" acceptance plan for the promptset A/B run with Acme. Goal: catch any quality regressions before customer-facing rollout and define clear owners and rollback criteria. Attachments: sentinel_tests_v1.csv (test set), sentinel_action_matrix.xlsx (owners + SLAs). Please read the short ask below and respond with owners, constraints, or redlines by EOD.

High-level asks:
- Product (Marissa): confirm the top 5 user-facing metrics that should gate the A/B (accuracy on taxonomy, hallucination rate, low-confidence fallback rate, latency P95, and coherence score). Also confirm whether a 3% drop on any single metric is auto-rollback or requires composite signal.
- SRE/Runtime (Soojin): confirm whether we can run the sentinel harness against the dedicated staging pool with KV cache priming and continuous batching enabled. Need guidance on canary throughput (suggest 5% traffic for 48h) and whether we can measure memory/kv-eviction signals during the test.
- DevRel/Telemetry (Logan): provide the event names and dashboards we should use for signal extraction. Need a one-click dashboard link we can include in the action matrix.
- CS/Success (Naomi): coordinate customer-facing notification language and whether Acme wants to be included in canary or prefer a behind-the-scenes trial.

Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
1) No metric drops > 3% absolute on any product gating metric for 48h at 5% canary.
2) No increase in hallucination-high-confidence prompts > 0.5% relative.
3) Latency P95 increase <= 15% and CPU/GPU anomaly rate < 1%.
4) No regression-triggered escalations from Acme during the canary window.

If we agree, I'll schedule a dry-run with EvalTools (Simon) tomorrow and run the sentinel tests against staging.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Eval Orchestration
Redwood Inference

--- attachments: sentinel_tests_v1.csv (csv stub), sentinel_action_matrix.xlsx (xls stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promptset Sentinel: acceptance handoff and cross-func action matrix

Thanks Karthik — this is a helpful start. A few clarifications from product:

- Metric list: agree on 4 of 5; replace "coherence score" with "intent preservation (recall@top1)" — easier to validate against labeled golden set.
- Rollback rules: I recommend a two-tier approach: any single metric drop > 5% -> immediate halt + notify leadership; any single metric drop between 3-5% -> hold and run second-pass tests (longer context, edge-case prompts) before deciding. Composite signal: if 2+ metrics drop >= 2.5% within 24h -> trigger canary extension and deeper triage.
- Timing: we need the dry-run today but the customer-facing canary should be scheduled next Tue (23 May) to align with Acme's release window.

Action owners I can commit to: product acceptance on intent-preservation thresholds and owning the labeled golden set. I'll also draft the language for "customer opt-in vs silent" and share with Naomi.

On quoting Karthik:
> Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
> 1) No metric drops > 3% absolute on any product gating metric for 48h at 5% canary.

We'll revise to the two-tier above.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr PM, Product - Eval Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Simon Park <simon.park@evaltools.io>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promptset Sentinel: acceptance handoff and cross-func action matrix

Appreciate the doc, Karthik. Operational notes:

- Staging capacity: we can run the sentinel harness against staging with KV priming, but we need to reserve a separate pool (non-shared) to avoid noisy neighbor effects. That means a short lead time to spin up (approx 6 hours) and a temporary capacity cost.
- Canary sizing: 5% traffic for 48h is reasonable for signal collection. For metric sensitivity, if Marissa moves to the two-tier rules, recommend we instrument an extended telemetry window (72h retention for detailed traces) to allow post-hoc analysis if metrics fall into the 3-5% gray area.
- Runtime telemetry: we will add two runtime signals to the action matrix: kv-eviction-rate and cache-priming-hit-rate. Both are already tracked by the serving runtime but need to be surfaced in Logan's dashboard.

Operational constraints / asks for the action matrix:
1) Product to confirm the final thresholds by EOD so we can provision the pool tomorrow.
2) Eval team (Karthik) to confirm the exact prompt set size and sampling strategy (stratified by domain and difficulty).
3) CS (Naomi) to confirm customer opt-in preference by EOD if Acme wants to be in the visible canary.

Linking the draft runbook: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SentinelDraft
HubSpot ref: hubspot:deal:ACME-4721

Onboarding EvalTools (Simon): Simon — please confirm you can run the harness with our staging tokens and export results in the CSV schema Karthik attached.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>, Simon Park <simon.park@evaltools.io>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promptset Sentinel: acceptance handoff and cross-func action matrix

Thanks all — quick recap and owners so we have a single source of truth: 

- Product (Marissa): finalize thresholds (intent-preservation + others) and update the action matrix (owner cell updated). Deliverable: thresholds doc by EOD.
- SRE (Soojin): provision non-shared staging pool and enable kv telemetry. Deliverable: pool up and telemetry surfaced by 2029-05-15 10:00 PT.
- Telemetry (Logan): create dashboard + one-click link and confirm event names in the action matrix. Deliverable: dashboard link and event mapping.
- CS (Naomi): confirm Acme opt-in/opt-out and draft customer-facing language for the canary. Deliverable: confirmation + language by EOD.
- Eval (me): run the dry-run with Simon today, deliver preliminary CSV results and a short triage note. Deliverable: dry-run artifacts and preliminary triage by EOD.

If there are disagreements to the two-tier rollback rule Marissa proposed, flag now; otherwise I will update the sentinel_action_matrix.xlsx and hand off to Ops for provisioning. I'll schedule a 30-min sync for tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize thresholds and confirm pool readiness.

Karthik
